description:
Dev-mode container services provisioned by the vidocq:dev goal (M4 of DEBUGMODE.md).
        Build-tooling only: these modules run in the Maven plugin JVM and MUST never land on the runtime
        module-path nor in the AOT/native image (DEBUGMODE.md §10). Hence no module-info.java — plain
        classpath jars loaded by the plugin's ServiceLoader. The one exception is
        vidocq-runtime-devservices-extension: it runs in the application itself, on the application's own
        module or class path, and has a module-info.java for that reason; it depends on nothing from this
        tree, only on vidocq-runtime-spi and vidocq-runtime-devconsole-spi.
